R4 — No-file-map task-impl path now routes to a single full-spec/full-diff RequirementGateBatch and one call flow, while integration with missing file-map trust input throws before any requirement call.

R5 — Requirement-evaluation objects continue to be produced with guardrail_id, result, reason, title, and category, and the diff shows no change to gatePass/gateFail artifact structure or added top-level required fields.

R6 — The diff adds R6-identified tests with the required spec header and coverage assertions for prompt-volume behavior, but test execution outcomes (node --test and npm test) are not provided, so this requirement cannot be confirmed from diff alone.
